name: a-gap-needs-no-comment
why: A No with nothing written against it is complete as far as the engine is concerned. The comment is optional on every question now — an observation the assessor may want to record against a Yes as readily as a No — and what a gap actually obliges is a corrective action, which the engine never sees. That rule lives in the submit gate, which does see the findings. What is pinned here is that the engine stopped asking for a comment it has no reason to require.
